views.name: V_REG_LIST
views.sql:
SELECT R.SEM_YR, R.SEM_SEQ, S.STD_NO, S.STD_NM, C.CRS_NM, P.PROF_NM, R.REG_STS
FROM UNI_TBT_REG R
  JOIN UNI_TBM_STD S ON R.STD_NO = S.STD_NO
  JOIN UNI_TBM_CRS C ON R.CRS_CD = C.CRS_CD
  JOIN UNI_TBD_SEM_CRS SC ON R.CRS_CD = SC.CRS_CD AND R.SEM_YR = SC.SEM_YR AND R.SEM_SEQ = SC.SEM_SEQ
  JOIN UNI_TBM_PROF P ON SC.PROF_NO = P.PROF_NO
ORDER BY R.SEM_YR DESC, R.SEM_SEQ DESC, S.STD_NO

views.name: V_GRADE_SUMMARY
views.sql:
SELECT S.STD_NO, S.STD_NM, G.SEM_YR, G.SEM_SEQ,
  SUM(C.CRDT_CNT) AS TOT_CREDIT,
  ROUND(SUM(G.GRD_SCORE * C.CRDT_CNT) / NULLIF(SUM(C.CRDT_CNT), 0), 2) AS GPA
FROM UNI_TBD_GRADE G
  JOIN UNI_TBM_STD S ON G.STD_NO = S.STD_NO
  JOIN UNI_TBM_CRS C ON G.CRS_CD = C.CRS_CD
WHERE G.GRD_SCORE IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY S.STD_NO, S.STD_NM, G.SEM_YR, G.SEM_SEQ
ORDER BY G.SEM_YR DESC, G.SEM_SEQ DESC, GPA DESC

views.name: V_CRS_OPEN
views.sql:
SELECT SC.SEM_YR, SC.SEM_SEQ, C.CRS_NM, P.PROF_NM, CL.CLSS_NM, SC.CRS_LIMIT,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM UNI_TBT_REG R
   WHERE R.CRS_CD = SC.CRS_CD AND R.SEM_YR = SC.SEM_YR AND R.SEM_SEQ = SC.SEM_SEQ) AS REG_CNT
FROM UNI_TBD_SEM_CRS SC
  JOIN UNI_TBM_CRS C ON SC.CRS_CD = C.CRS_CD
  JOIN UNI_TBM_PROF P ON SC.PROF_NO = P.PROF_NO
  JOIN UNI_TBM_CLSS CL ON SC.CLSS_CD = CL.CLSS_CD
WHERE SC.USE_YN = 'Y'
ORDER BY SC.SEM_YR DESC, SC.SEM_SEQ DESC, C.CRS_NM

views.name: V_PREREQ_TREE
views.sql:
SELECT C1.CRS_NM AS COURSE, C2.CRS_NM AS REQUIRES
FROM UNI_TBD_PREREQ P
  JOIN UNI_TBM_CRS C1 ON P.CRS_CD = C1.CRS_CD
  JOIN UNI_TBM_CRS C2 ON P.PREREQ_CRS_CD = C2.CRS_CD
ORDER BY C1.CRS_NM
